regions.region: title, abstract, introduction, and lower-right Scheme 1 on the original page
regions.finding: Scheme 1 is a generic comparison of established allylation and an envisioned allene/carbometallation route; classified as a general scheme. Abstract and introduction contain broad claims and cited prior work, not independent present-paper batches.

unresolved: Generic LG/Nu/R/n/M/L* structures and experiment-level conditions are not defined.

regions.finding: Ligand structures L1–L7 and substituent identities were inspected; the arrows describe ligand-design evolution, not reported ligand-synthesis experiments on this page.

regions.region: middle discussion and lower Table 1 with footnotes
regions.finding: Fourteen independent optimization rows extracted. Parenthesized values are recoveries of 1a, not product yields; entries 13 and 14 use 0.6 and 0.8 mmol 2a, respectively. Entry 14 is merged with Table 2 3aa and the page-4 typical procedure.

unresolved: Table 1 entry 6 reports 87% ee while the prose states 86%; both are retained.
The signed −70 entry is represented as 70% ee for the prose-identified (S)-product.
Most rows omit atmosphere, workup, and purification.

regions.region: upper and middle Table 2 reaction drawing, 15 structures, and footnote
regions.finding: Fifteen substrate-scope outcomes inspected. The shared 0.2 mmol 1, 0.8 mmol 2, 0.08 mmol Ag3PO4, 5 mol% Pd(dba)2/L7, 2 mL THF, 110 °C, 25–67 h conditions and isolated-yield/chiral-HPLC bases were applied. The 3aa row is merged with Table 1 entry 14.

regions.region: lower-left Figure 2 NOE study and adjacent scope discussion
regions.finding: Figure 2 supports the E assignment of 3ah; it is evidence for the scope record rather than a separate experiment. The prose identifies ether, amide, MOM and 1,3-disubstituted-allene tolerance.

unresolved: Only a shared 25–67 h range is given; row-specific scope durations are unknown.
Atmosphere, workup, and purification are absent for the abbreviated scope entries.
Complex structures and stereochemistry remain unverified machine candidates.

regions.region: upper-left Experimental Section typical procedure for (R)-3
regions.finding: Detailed preparation of (R)-3aa merged into Table 1 entry 14/Table 2 3aa, adding exact masses and mmol, 2 h catalyst-ligand premixing, sequential additions, TLC endpoint, vacuum evaporation, chromatography, product mass, HPLC details, and rotation.
No additional present-paper reaction batch. Footnote 9 supports the R assignment of 3af by comparison to prior data but points to unavailable SI for details.

unresolved: The typical procedure does not state atmosphere.
SI is advertised but was not supplied or explicitly associated.
Analytical characterization supports identity but does not independently verify candidate connectivity or absolute stereochemistry.
